description: Figures for one model as Census EV publishes them on its model page and its market page: how many are for sale and as of when; cars for sale and median asking price by model year; the mileage-adjusted asking price of a used one at 40,000 miles with its 30- and 60-day change; and the share of used ones no longer listed 30 days after they appeared, with the window it was measured over. A figure is null or absent where the site prints none, because too few cars stand behind it or it could not be read.

make.description: Make, e.g. "Hyundai". Case, spacing and common short forms ("Chevy", "VW") are accepted.

model.description: Model, e.g. "Ioniq 5". Punctuation and spacing are ignored.
